actionable_steps.citation: Sadhana and Seva — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 18 (1985), 1985-07-07
actionable_steps.step: Decide your goal first — know clearly what you want to achieve — and then carry the sadhana through until you reach it.

actionable_steps.citation: Sadhana and Seva — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 18 (1985), 1985-07-07
actionable_steps.step: Treat every obstacle as a test for promotion, not a punishment, and keep going without losing faith.

actionable_steps.citation: Purity of the Heart is True Sadhana — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 38 (2005), 2005-10-09
actionable_steps.step: Take up the simple sadhana of constant contemplation on the omnipresent God — purity of heart is the whole point of every practice.
Begin today the discipline meant for tomorrow — dig the well before the house catches fire.
Aim your practice at God-realisation alone — practices done to win favours or exploit the world will lead you astray.

actionable_steps.citation: Give up selfishness and strive for selfrealisation — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 39 (2006), 2006-09-27
actionable_steps.step: Contemplate 'Soham' with every breath, from the time you wake till you sleep — reminding yourself that you are Brahman.

definition.citation: Purity - The Path To Liberation — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 30 (1997), 1997-05-15
definition.quote: Sadhana means elimination of the evil tendencies in man and acquiring good and sacred qualities. True sadhana is the eradication of all evil in a man. … To remove all the impurities in the mind is real Sadhana.

discourses.citation: Sadhana and Seva — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 18 (1985), 1985-07-07
discourses.quote: Sadhana refers to an activity undertaken for achieving one's goal or purpose in life. … Then Sadhana has to be carried on until one achieves that goal.

discourses.citation: Sadhana and Seva — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 18 (1985), 1985-07-07
discourses.quote: When obstacles come they should be taken as tests. Tests are intended not as punishment, but they are given for ascertaining one's fitness for promotion. Frequent tests mean frequent opportunities for promotion.

discourses.citation: Purity of the Heart is True Sadhana — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 38 (2005), 2005-10-09
discourses.quote: No sadhana would help in realising God, if one is devoid of purity of the heart. … All kinds of sadhana are meant only to attain purity. The moment you attain purity of the heart, the omnipresent God will manifest right in front of you.

discourses.citation: Give up selfishness and strive for selfrealisation — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 39 (2006), 2006-09-27
discourses.quote: Sadhana does not mean mere physical exercise. It is an enquiry into Truth at the level of the mind and intellect.

make_it_real: Sadhana is not what you do on a cushion — it's the impurities you remove from your mind today.
title: Sadhana / Spiritual Practice

vahinis.quote: Start today the spiritual discipline that has to be done tomorrow! Start now the spiritual discipline that has to be done today! One doesn't know what is in store the next moment; therefore, there should be no delay in engaging oneself in the spiritual practice that has to be done.
Only that intense spiritual practice is proper that has as its aim the attainment of God, the realisation of Brahman, the achievement of the highest wisdom.
